BiblicalUsage: Maok, also spelled Maoch, was the father of Achish, king of Gath, and his name stands once, when David passed over with his six hundred men to Achish, the son of Maoch. The Philistine king who sheltered David was the son of a man whose name Scripture keeps.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Maok's single mention matters, because even the father of a Philistine king is named when David's story passes through his house.
